findings.evidence: Mathlib defines `AddSubgroup G` under `[AddGroup G]` (Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Defs.lean:303), and the existing additive minimum-distance API already uses `[∀ i, AddGroup (β i)]` (MinimumDistance/Basic.lean:172); commutativity is needed only by this PR's proof route through `toIntSubmodule`.
findings.fix: Define the carrier directly under `[AddGroup A]`, generalize its equivalence/cardinality/order and distance API accordingly, and place only the `toIntSubmodule` characterization and linear-code bridge in commutative/ring-specific sections.
findings.issue: `AddSubgroup.directSum` and every derived construction theorem require `[AddCommGroup A]`, although coordinatewise direct sums of additive subgroups only require `[AddGroup A]`; the same overrestriction reaches the three distance theorems at Operations.lean:285.

summary: The new root-level additive direct-sum API is unnecessarily restricted to commutative additive groups.
